title: Taqdimot (prezentatsiya)
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha aniq tuzilgan 3 daqiqalik taqdimot qilasiz: tinglovchini tortuvchi ochilish, signposting iboralari bilan mantiqiy oqim, slayd va diagrammalarni tanishtirish, savol-javobni professional boshqarish hamda kuchli yakun bilan harakatga chaqirish.
homework_uz: Uch daqiqalik taqdimotingizni yozib oling (telefonda ovoz yozish yetarli): kuchli ochilish, uchta asosiy nuqta signposting bilan, kamida bitta slayd tavsifi, savol-javobdan keyin harakatga chaqiruv bilan yakun. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: yozuv 3 daqiqadan oshmasin, har bir asosiy nuqtada kamida bitta signposting iborasi ishlatilsin va oxirida aniq call to action bo‘lsin. Yozuvni ikki marta tinglab, pauza va temponi baholang. Keyingi dars: P1-08 Mijozlar bilan ishlash.

vocab.uz: ochilish ilgagi — tinglovchini tortuvchi birinchi gap

vocab.w: Could you repeat the question, please?

vocab.uz: aniq harakatga chaqiruv ('Please approve the budget by Friday.')
tana tili — ko‘z muloqoti, turish, imo-ishoralar

scenes.title: Taqdimot darsiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda uchrashuv va yig‘ilishlarni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa eng mas’uliyatli qism — taqdimot. Uch daqiqada ishonch bilan gapirishni o‘rganasiz: ochilish, signposting, slaydlar, savollar va yakun. Oxirida 3 daqiqalik taqdimotingiz tayyor bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson covered meetings — agendas, taking the floor, decisions. Today: the most demanding part of any meeting — the presentation. You'll learn to open strong, signpost clearly, present visuals, handle questions and close with impact.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda uchrashuv va yig‘ilishlarni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa yig‘ilishning eng mas’uliyatli qismi — taqdimot. Uch daqiqada ishonch bilan gapirishni o‘rganasiz: ochilish, signposting, slaydlar, savollar va yakun. Oxirida 3 daqiqalik taqdimotingiz tayyor bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: 3 daqiqa qanday rejalashtiriladi

examples.t: Three minutes is about 380 words — plan, don't improvise.

scenes.say_native: Uch daqiqa — juda oz vaqt, har soniyasi hisoblanadi. Formula: 30 soniya ochilish, ikki daqiqa tana — uchta asosiy nuqta, 30 soniya yakun va savollar. Bitta slayd bir fikrni anglatadi; zich slayd tinglovchini charchatadi. Uch daqiqa taxminan 380 so‘z — skeleti yodlang, matnni emas, qolgani tabiiy kelsin.
scenes.say: Three minutes, every second counts. The shape: thirty seconds of opening, two minutes of body — three key points — then thirty seconds of close and questions. One slide, one idea. Three minutes is roughly 380 words — memorise the skeleton, not the script.
scenes.say_uz: Uch daqiqa — har soniyasi hisoblanadi. Formula: 30 soniya ochilish, ikki daqiqa tana — uchta asosiy nuqta, 30 soniya yakun va savollar. Bitta slayd bir fikr. Uch daqiqa taxminan 380 so‘z — skeleti yodlang, matnni emas.

scenes.title: Kuchli ochilish: hook turlari

examples.t: What if I told you we could save 15% next quarter?
examples.uz: Keyingi chorakda 15 foizni tejay olamiz desam, nima deysiz?

examples.t: In 2025, out-of-stocks cost us two million a month.
examples.uz: 2025-yilda yetishmovchilik oyiga ikki million so‘mga tushdi.

scenes.say_native: Ochilish — birinchi o‘ttiz soniyada tinglovchini qozonasiz yoki yo‘qotasiz. Hook uch turi: raqam, savol ('What if I told you…?') yoki o‘ttiz soniyalik hikoya. Keyin ismingiz, mavzu va agenda — 'First the problem, then the data, finally the proposal.' 'Hi, my name is…' bilan boshlamang.
scenes.say: The opening decides whether you win the room in thirty seconds. Three hook types: a striking number, an unexpected question — 'What if I told you…?' — or a thirty-second story. Then: your name, topic, agenda — 'First the problem, then the data, finally the proposal.' Never open with 'Hi, my name is…'.
scenes.say_uz: Ochilish — birinchi o‘ttiz soniyada tinglovchini qozonasiz yoki yo‘qotasiz. Hook uch turi: raqam, savol ('What if…?') yoki o‘ttiz soniyalik hikoya. Keyin ismingiz, mavzu va agenda — 'First the problem, then the data, finally the proposal.' 'Hi, my name is…' bilan boshlamang.

scenes.title: Namuna: uch xil kuchli ochilish
scenes.say_native: Uch ochilishni solishtiring. Raqam hooki analitik tinglovchiga mos; savol hooki ziddiyatli mavzuga; hikoya hooki insoniy ulanish uchun. Uchalasida ham umumiy narsa: tinglovchi birinchi o‘n soniyada qiziqib qoladi, siz esa hali birinchi slaydga o‘tmagansiz.
scenes.say: Number hook: 'Last quarter, one in five deliveries arrived late — today I'll show you why, and how we fix it.' Question hook: 'What if every late delivery cost us a client? It nearly happened three times this year.' Story hook: 'On Monday, a client called in tears — her order never came. That call changed this project.'
scenes.say_uz: Raqam hooki: 'Last quarter, one in five deliveries arrived late — today I'll show you why, and how we fix it.' Savol hooki: 'What if every late delivery cost us a client?' Hikoya hooki: 'On Monday, a client called in tears — her order never came. That call changed this project.'

scenes.title: Ochilishingizni yozing
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizning ochilishingizni yozing. Tasavvur qiling: keyingi haftada jamoaga taqdimot qilasiz — 'Nima uchun biz yangi CRM'ga o‘tishimiz kerak'. Raqam hooki bilan boshlang, keyin ismingiz va uch qismli agenda. Yigirma soniyada bir-ikki jumla yozing va ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.
scenes.say: Write your own opening. Imagine presenting to your team next week: 'Why we must move to the new CRM.' Open with a number hook, then your name and a three-part agenda. Twenty seconds — two sentences, spoken aloud.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizning ochilishingizni yozing. Tasavvur: jamoaga 'Nima uchun yangi CRM'ga o‘tishimiz kerak' taqdimoti. Raqam hooki, ismingiz va uch qismli agenda. Yigirma soniya — bir-ikki jumla, ovoz chiqarib.

scenes.title: Javoblar: kuchli ochilish

examples.t: Sixty per cent of our leads go cold in 48 hours.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar va mezonlar. Birinchi qator hook bo‘lsin — raqam, savol yoki hikoya; ism ikkinchi o‘ringa. Agenda uch qismdan oshmasin: 'problem, data, proposal'. Ochilish o‘ttiz soniyaga sig‘masa, tinglovchi telefonga qarayapti. Yaxshi ochilish: qisqa, aniq, birinchi jumlada raqam yoki savol.
scenes.say: Answers and criteria. Line one is the hook; your name comes second. The agenda stays in three parts — problem, data, proposal. If the opening exceeds thirty seconds, the room is already on their phones. Benchmark: short, concrete, a number or a question in the very first line.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar va mezonlar. Birinchi qator hook; ism ikkinchi o‘ringa. Agenda uch qism — problem, data, proposal. Ochilish o‘ttiz soniyadan oshsa, tinglovchi telefonga qarayapti. Mezon: qisqa, aniq, birinchi jumlada raqam yoki savol.

scenes.title: Signposting: birinchi guruh iboralar

examples.t: I'd like to start with the numbers.
Moving on to the second point — churn.

scenes.say_native: Signposting — tinglovchining ichki GPS'i: qaysi bekatda ekanini biladi. Boshlash: 'I'd like to start with…', 'Let me begin by…'. O‘tish: 'Moving on to…', 'Now let's look at…'. Xulosalash: 'To sum up…', 'In short…'. Har qirq-besh soniyada bitta signpost — tinglovchi adashtirmaydi va takror so‘rashmaydi.
scenes.say: Signposting is your audience's GPS — they always know which stop they're at. Starting: 'I'd like to start with…', 'Let me begin by…'. Transitions: 'Moving on to…', 'Now let's look at…'. Closing: 'To sum up…', 'In short…'. One signpost every forty-five seconds — listeners never get lost.
scenes.say_uz: Signposting — tinglovchining ichki GPS'i. Boshlash: 'I'd like to start with…', 'Let me begin by…'. O‘tish: 'Moving on to…', 'Now let's look at…'. Xulosalash: 'To sum up…', 'In short…'. Har qirq-besh soniyada bitta signpost — tinglovchi adashtirmaydi.

scenes.title: Namuna: signposting bilan nutq parchasi
scenes.say_native: Nutq parchasini tinglang va signpostlarni ichingizda sanang. Jasur uch nuqtani tartib bilan ochadi, har biriga kirish beradi va xulosaga o‘tadi. Diqqat qiling: signposting jumlalari qisqa — ikki-to‘rt so‘z, nutq oqimini to‘xtatmaydi, balki yo‘naltiradi.
scenes.say: First, let me show you the delivery data for March. As you can see, delays peak on Fridays. Next, why Fridays break — the pattern repeats across three months. Finally, my proposal: shift the warehouse cut-off to Thursday. To sum up: later cut-off, earlier pickups, fewer Friday meltdowns.
scenes.say_uz: First, let me show you the delivery data for March. Ko‘rib turganingizdek, kechikishlar juma kunlari cho‘qqiga chiqadi. Next, why Fridays break — bu naqsh uch oy takrorlanadi. Finally, my proposal: shift the warehouse cut-off to Thursday. To sum up: later cut-off, fewer Friday meltdowns.

scenes.title: Signpostni tanlang
board: '___ to the data, four slides follow.'
scenes.say_native: Ikkita bo‘sh joyni to‘ldiring. Birinchi: '___ to the data, four slides follow' — qaysi ibora? Ikkinchi: '___, here are three next steps' — xulosaga o‘tish iborasi qaysi? Ovoz chiqarib, har biriga javob ayting. Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Fill in the two gaps aloud. Gap one: '—— to the data, four slides follow.' Which phrase fits? Gap two: '——, here are three next steps.' Which phrase opens a summary? Say both out loud. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita bo‘sh joyni to‘ldiring. Birinchi: '—— to the data, four slides follow.' Qaysi ibora? Ikkinchi: '——, here are three next steps.' Qaysi ibora xulosani ochadi? Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: signpost mashqi

examples.t: Turning to the data, four slides follow.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi bo‘sh joy — 'Turning to the data' yoki 'Moving on to the data'; 'go to' demaymiz, bu norasmiy. Ikkinchi — 'To sum up' yoki 'In short' — xulosaga o‘tish. Signpostlar gap boshida vergul bilan ajraladi va ikki-to‘rt so‘z bo‘ladi — uzun signpost nutqqa aylanib ketadi.
scenes.say: Answers. Gap one: 'Turning to the data' or 'Moving on to the data' — avoid 'go to', it sounds casual. Gap two: 'To sum up' or 'In short'. Signposts sit at the start of a sentence, after a comma, and stay within two to four words — a longer signpost becomes a speech.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Birinchi bo‘sh joy — 'Turning to the data' yoki 'Moving on to the data'; 'go to' demang. Ikkinchi — 'To sum up' yoki 'In short'. Signpostlar gap boshida vergul bilan ajraladi va ikki-to‘rt so‘z bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Namuna: ochilish + signposting to‘liq
scenes.say_native: To‘liq ochilish parchasini tinglang: raqam hooki, ism, uch qismli agenda va birinchi nuqtaga o‘tish. Jasur dastlabki oltmish soniyada tinglovchini to‘liq o‘ziga oladi. Ichingizda sanang: hook qancha oldi, agenda nechta so‘zda aytildi.
scenes.say: Good morning. Sixty per cent of our leads go cold within forty-eight hours — nearly nine hundred lost opportunities a year. I'm Jasur, head of sales ops. Here's my plan: first, the data; then the root causes; finally, a fix we can deploy this month. I'd like to start with the data — four slides, two minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Good morning. Sixty per cent of our leads go cold within forty-eight hours — yiliga deyarli to‘qqiz yuzta yo‘qolgan imkoniyat. I'm Jasur, head of sales ops. Rejam: first, the data; then the root causes; finally, a fix we can deploy this month. I'd like to start with the data — four slides, two minutes.

scenes.title: Birinchi minutni gapiring
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi minutni ovoz chiqarib ayting: hook, ismingiz, uch qismli agenda va birinchi nuqtaga signpost. Vaqtni hisoblang — o‘ttiz soniyaga sig‘ishi shart. Adashsangiz to‘xtamang; ikkinchi urinishda farqni sezasiz.
scenes.say: Speak your full first minute aloud: hook, your name, three-part agenda, then one signpost into point one. Time yourself — thirty seconds, no more. Stumble? Carry on, then do a second take.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi minutni ovoz chiqarib ayting: hook, ismingiz, uch qismli agenda va birinchi nuqtaga signpost. Oltmish emas — o‘ttiz soniya. Adashsangiz to‘xtamang; ikkinchi urinishda farq ko‘rasiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar: birinchi minut

examples.t: Self-check: hook, name, agenda, signpost — tick each.
examples.uz: O‘zingizni tekshiring: hook, ism, agenda, signpost.

scenes.say_native: O‘z-o‘zingizni tekshiring: hook ikki jumladan oshdimi? Agenda o‘n so‘zdan oshdimi? Birinchi nuqtaga signpost bormi? O‘ttiz soniyadan oshdimi? To‘rttasini belgilang; bittasi bo‘lmasa — faqat shu qismni qaytaring. Birinchi minut qancha puxta bo‘lsa, qolgan ikki daqiqa shuncha oson.
scenes.say: Self-check, four ticks: hook under two sentences? Agenda under ten words? A signpost into point one? Inside thirty seconds? Any missing tick — redo just that part. The tighter your first minute, the easier the next two become.
scenes.say_uz: O‘z-o‘zingizni tekshiring: hook ikki jumladan oshdimi? Agenda o‘n so‘zdan oshdimi? Birinchi nuqtaga signpost bormi? O‘ttiz soniyada sig‘dingizmi? Belgisi yo‘q qismni qaytaring. Birinchi minut puxta bo‘lsa, qolgani oson.

scenes.title: Slaydlarni tanishtirish: 4 formula

examples.t: As you can see, delays peak on Fridays.
examples.uz: Ko‘rib turganingizdek, kechikishlar juma kuni cho‘qqiga chiqadi.

examples.t: The key figure here is 18 per cent churn.
examples.uz: Mana bu yerda asosiy raqam — 18 foiz ketish.

scenes.say_native: Slaydni ochishning to‘rt formulasi. Birinchi: 'As you can see…' — oddiy ko‘rsatish. Ikkinchi: 'This chart shows…' — graf uchun. Uchinchi: 'The key figure here is…' — bitta raqamni ajratish. To‘rtinchi: 'If you compare column A with B…' — solishtirish. Slayd matnini o‘qimang — tinglovchi o‘zi o‘qiydi, siz tushuntirasiz.
scenes.say: Four formulas open any slide. One: 'As you can see…' — simple pointing. Two: 'This chart shows…' — for graphs. Three: 'The key figure here is…' — spotlight one number. Four: 'If you compare column A with B…' — for contrast. Never read the slide aloud — you explain it.
scenes.say_uz: Slaydni ochishning to‘rt formulasi. 'As you can see…' — ko‘rsatish. 'This chart shows…' — graf uchun. 'The key figure here is…' — raqamni ajratish. 'If you compare column A with B…' — solishtirish. Slaydni o‘qimang — tushuntiring.

scenes.title: Namuna: grafni tushuntirish
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang: Nilufar grafikni to‘rt qadamda tushuntiradi — slaydni ochadi, eng muhim raqamni ko‘rsatadi, sababni aytadi, xulosa bilan bog‘laydi. Esda qiling: u grafikni yod olmadi, faqat formulalar ishlatdi.
scenes.say: As you can see, this is our delivery performance for Q1. The key figure here is 22 per cent late orders in March — nearly double February. Why: one warehouse shift short-staffed, two new carriers onboarding. So the chart isn't bad news — it's a diagnosis. And the fix is in the next three slides.
scenes.say_uz: As you can see, this is our delivery performance for Q1. The key figure here is 22 per cent late orders in March — deyarli ikki baravar. Why: one warehouse shift short-staffed, two new carriers onboarding. So the chart isn't bad news — it's a diagnosis. The fix is in the next three slides.

scenes.title: Grafni ta’riflang
scenes.say_native: Xayoliy grafik: yetkazish kechikishlari, mart oyida 22 foiz. Uni to‘rt qadamda tushuntiring: 'This chart shows…' bilan oching, asosiy raqamni ayting, sabab taklif qiling, bir jumla xulosa bering. Yigirma besh soniya, ovoz chiqarib.
scenes.say: Imagine this chart: March late orders at 22 per cent. Explain it in four beats aloud: open with 'This chart shows…', name the key figure, propose one cause, close with a one-line takeaway. Twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Xayoliy grafik: mart oyida 22 foiz kechikish. To‘rt qadamda ovoz chiqarib tushuntiring: 'This chart shows…', asosiy raqam, sabab, bir jumlalik xulosa. Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: graf tavsifi

examples.t: This chart shows March — 22 per cent late, driven by staffing.
examples.uz: Bu grafik martni ko‘rsatadi — 22 foiz, asosi kadrlar.

scenes.say_native: Javob kaliti: bir — 'This chart shows our March delivery performance.' Ikki — asosiy raqam 22 foiz, fevralning ikki baravari. Uch — sabab: kadrlar yetishmovchiligi yoki tashuvchi muammosi. To‘rt — xulosa: 'So the chart tells us where to fix first.' Bu to‘rt qadam har qanday slaydga mos keladi.
scenes.say: Answer key. One — 'This chart shows our March delivery performance.' Two — the key figure: 22 per cent, nearly double February. Three — a cause: short staffing or carrier issues. Four — a takeaway: 'So the chart tells us where to fix first.' These four beats fit any slide.
scenes.say_uz: Javob kaliti. Bir — 'This chart shows our March delivery performance.' Ikki — asosiy raqam 22 foiz. Uch — sabab: kadrlar yoki tashuvchi. To‘rt — xulosa: 'So the chart tells us where to fix first.' Bu to‘rt qadam har qanday slaydga mos.

scenes.title: Savollarni boshqarish: A.C.A.R.
board: Clarify: 'Do you mean X or Y?'

examples.t: That's a good question — cost or timing?

scenes.say_native: Savol-javobning formulasi — A.C.A.R.: Acknowledge — 'That's a good question'; Clarify — 'Do you mean cost or timing?'; Answer — uch jumlada; Reinforce — 'So to summarise…' bilan qayting. Bilmasangiz: 'I'll find out and follow up tomorrow' — bu halollik, kuchsizlik emas.
scenes.say: Handle Q&A with A-C-A-R. Acknowledge: 'That's a good question.' Clarify: 'Do you mean cost or timing?' — shrink the question. Answer in at most three sentences. Reinforce: 'So to summarise…' — back to your core message. And when you don't know: 'I'll find out and follow up tomorrow.' That's professional, not weak.
scenes.say_uz: Savol-javobning formulasi — A.C.A.R. Acknowledge — 'That's a good question'. Clarify — 'Do you mean cost or timing?' Answer — uch jumlada. Reinforce — 'So to summarise…' bilan asosiy xabarga qayting. Bilmasangiz — 'I'll find out and follow up tomorrow.' Bu halollik.

scenes.title: Namuna: qiyin savolga javob
scenes.say_native: Qiyin savolga namuna javobni tinglang: 'Why did this fail last time?' Jasur himoyaga o‘tmadi — avval sababni tan oldi, keyin tushuntirdi, yangi himoya bilan bog‘lab ko‘prik qurdi. Savol hujum emas, qiziqishning belgisi deb qabul qiling.
scenes.say: Audience: 'Why did this fail last time?' You: 'Fair question — honestly, we launched without training. This time training is week one, not an afterthought. The failure taught us the order of operations, and this plan reflects it. Does that address your concern?' No defensiveness — one cause, one concrete change.
scenes.say_uz: Audience: 'Why did this fail last time?' You: 'Fair question — honestly, we launched without training. This time training is week one, not an afterthought. The failure taught us the order of operations, and this plan reflects it. Does that address your concern?' Bir sabab, bitta aniq o‘zgarish.

scenes.title: To‘rtta savolga javob bering
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta odatiy savolga A.C.A.R. bilan javob bering: 'Why now?', 'How much will it cost?', 'Who owns this project?', 'What if it fails?' Har biriga acknowledge + qisqa javob + ko‘prik. Yigirma besh soniya, ovoz chiqarib.
scenes.say: Answer four classic questions with A-C-A-R. One: 'Why now?' Two: 'How much will it cost?' Three: 'Who owns this?' Four: 'What if it fails?' Each gets an acknowledge, a short answer, and a bridge back to your message. Twenty-five seconds, aloud.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savolga A.C.A.R. bilan javob bering: 'Why now?', 'How much will it cost?', 'Who owns this?', 'What if it fails?' Har biriga acknowledge, qisqa javob, ko‘prik. Yigirma besh soniya, ovoz chiqarib.

scenes.title: Javoblar: to‘rt savol

examples.t: Fair question — the window closes in September.

scenes.say_native: Javob namunalari. 'Why now?' — 'Fair question — the window closes in September.' 'Cost?' — 'Forty million sums, payback in six months.' 'Who owns this?' — 'Sales ops leads, with IT on the CRM side.' 'What if it fails?' — 'A three-month pilot with a clear stop point.' Har javob acknowledge bilan boshlanadi.
scenes.say: Model answers. 'Why now?' — 'Fair question — the window closes in September.' 'Cost?' — 'Forty million, payback in six months.' 'Who owns this?' — 'Sales ops leads, IT on the CRM side.' 'What if it fails?' — 'A three-month pilot with a clear stop point.' Every answer opens with acknowledge.
scenes.say_uz: Javob namunalari. 'Why now?' — 'Fair question — the window closes in September.' 'Cost?' — 'Qirq million, olti oyda.' 'Who owns this?' — 'Sales ops + IT.' 'What if it fails?' — 'Uch oylik pilot, aniq stop point.' Har javob acknowledge bilan boshlanadi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: choraklik natijalar taqdimoti
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — choraklik natijalar taqdimoti; Rahim bosh menejer sifatida savol beradi. Nilufar hook bilan ochadi, signpost bilan uch nuqtaga o‘tadi va slaydlarni to‘rt formula bilan tushuntiradi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — keyingi sahifada to‘rt savol kutadi.
scenes.say: Nilufar: One number first: revenue grew 18 per cent — but margin fell 3 points. I'm Nilufar, finance lead. First, revenue; then costs; finally, the fix. Turning to the data — as you can see, March drove half the growth. The key figure here is 18 per cent. Rahim: What's the three-point margin leak? Nilufar: Freight and discounts. Moving on — costs.
scenes.say_uz: Nilufar: One number first: revenue grew 18 per cent — but margin fell 3 points. I'm Nilufar, finance lead. First, revenue; then costs; finally, the fix. Turning to the data — March drove half the growth. The key figure here is 18 per cent. Rahim: What's the three-point margin leak? Nilufar: Freight and discounts. Moving on — costs are the next slide.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: hook qaysi raqam edi? Ikki: uchta asosiy nuqta nima edi? Uch: 'As you can see' iborasi nimani ko‘rsatdi? To‘rt: Rahim qaysi savolni berdi? Javoblarni ichingizda saqlang — keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what was the hook number? Two: what were Nilufar's three points? Three: what did 'As you can see' point to? Four: what did Rahim ask? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: hook qaysi raqam edi? Ikki: uch nuqta nima edi? Uch: 'As you can see' nimani ko‘rsatdi? To‘rt: Rahim qaysi savolni berdi? Javoblarni ichingizda saqlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: hook — 18 foiz o‘sish, margin uch ball tushishi. Ikki: uch nuqta — revenue, costs, fix — xronologik tartibda. Uch: 'As you can see' — mart oyi o‘sishning yarmini ta’minlaganini ko‘rsatdi. To‘rt: Rahim uch ballik margin sizishi qayerdan ekanini so‘radi — javob: freight va chegirmalar.
scenes.say: Answers. One: the hook — 18 per cent growth, margin down three points. Two: three points — revenue, costs, fix — chronological. Three: 'As you can see' showed March driving half the growth. Four: Rahim asked where the three-point margin leak came from — Nilufar answered: freight and discounts.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: hook — 18 foiz o‘sish, margin uch ball tushishi. Ikki: revenue, costs, fix. Uch: 'As you can see' — mart o‘sishning yarmi. To‘rt: Rahim margin sizishi qayerdan ekanini so‘radi — javob: freight va chegirmalar.

scenes.title: Kuchli yopilish: uch qism

examples.t: To sum up: pilot in May, decision in June.
examples.uz: Xulosa: may oyida pilot, iyunda qaror.

scenes.say_native: Yopilish uch qismdan iborat. Bir: xulosa — 'To sum up' bilan uch nuqtani bitta qatorga sig‘diring. Ikki: harakatga chaqiruv — aniq, vaqt bilan: 'Please approve the budget by Friday.' Uch: 'What questions do you have?' bilan oching — 'Any questions?' emas, u savolni kamsitadi. 'Thank you' faqat oxirida.
scenes.say: A strong close has three parts. One: the summary — squeeze your three points into one line with 'To sum up…'. Two: a call to action, specific and timed — 'Please approve the budget by Friday.' Three: open the floor with 'What questions do you have?' — never 'Any questions?'. 'Thank you' closes, never opens.
scenes.say_uz: Yopilish uch qismdan iborat. Bir: xulosa — 'To sum up'. Ikki: harakatga chaqiruv — 'Please approve the budget by Friday.' Uch: savollarga 'What questions do you have?' bilan oching — 'Any questions?' emas. 'Thank you' — faqat oxirida.

scenes.title: Namuna: kuchli yopilish
scenes.say_native: Namuna yopilishni tinglang: xulosa bitta jumlada, keyin aniq harakat va sana, oxirida savollarga taklif. Jasurning yakuni o‘ttiz soniyada tugaydi va tinglovchida 'keyin nima qilish kerak' degan aniq javob qoldiradi.
scenes.say: To sum up: we know where late orders come from — Fridays and freight — and the fix is a Thursday cut-off plus a carrier review. So here's my ask: approve the pilot for May, and we'll report back on the first of June. What questions do you have? Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: To sum up: we know where late orders come from — Fridays and freight — and the fix is a Thursday cut-off plus a carrier review. So here's my ask: approve the pilot for May, and we'll report back on the first of June. What questions do you have? Thank you.

scenes.title: Yopilishingizni yozing
scenes.say_native: O‘z yopilishingizni yozing: CRM loyihasi bo‘yicha 'To sum up' bilan uch qismni bitta jumlada takrorlang, keyin 'Please approve…' bilan harakat va aniq sanani qo‘ying, oxirida savollarga taklif qiling. Yigirma-o‘ttiz soniya.
scenes.say: Write your close for the CRM project: one line with 'To sum up…', then 'Please approve…' with a specific date, then invite questions. Twenty to thirty seconds — write it, then say it aloud.
scenes.say_uz: O‘z yopilishingizni yozing: 'To sum up' bilan bitta jumla, keyin 'Please approve…' + aniq sana, oxirida savollarga taklif. Yigirma-o‘ttiz soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: yopilish

examples.t: To sum up: pilot in May — approve by Friday?

scenes.say_native: Javob mezoni. Xulosa — bitta jumla. Harakat — fe’l + sana: 'approve by Friday'. Savollar — 'What questions do you have?', hech qachon 'Any questions?'. 'Thank you' — oxirgi so‘z bo‘lsin. Shu mezonlarga mos bo‘lsa, taqdimotingiz professional darajada tugagan hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: Answer criteria. The summary is one sentence. The action pairs an imperative with a date — 'approve by Friday.' Questions open with 'What questions do you have?' — never 'Any questions?'. 'Thank you' is the final word. Meet these and your close is professional grade.
scenes.say_uz: Javob mezoni. Xulosa — bitta jumla. Harakat — fe’l + sana: 'approve by Friday'. Savollar — 'What questions do you have?' — 'Any questions?' emas. 'Thank you' — oxirgi so‘z. Shu mezonlarga mos bo‘lsa — professional yakun.

scenes.title: Keng tarqalgan 6 xato
scenes.say_native: Olti xatoni bartaraf eting. Bir: slayd o‘qish — tinglovchi o‘qiy oladi, siz tushuntirasiz. Ikki: 'ummm' — jimlik bilan to‘ldiring. Uch: tezlik — 150 so‘z idealdan tez — tushunilmaydi. To‘rt: savollardan qo‘rqish — A.C.A.R. mashq. Besh: yopiq tana tili — qo‘llarni ochiq tuting. Oltinchi: vaqtni oshirish — uch daqiqa oltiga aylanmaydi.
scenes.say: Fix six mistakes. One: reading slides — your audience reads; you explain. Two: 'ummm' — replace with a pause. Three: speed — one hundred fifty words a minute; faster, nobody absorbs it. Four: fearing questions — drill A-C-A-R. Five: closed body language — open your hands. Six: overrunning — three minutes means three minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Olti xatoni bartaraf eting. Bir: slayd o‘qish — siz tushuntirasiz. Ikki: 'ummm' — jimlik bilan almashtiring. Uch: daqiqasiga 150 so‘z — undan tez — tushunilmaydi. To‘rt: savollardan qo‘rqish — A.C.A.R. mashq. Besh: yopiq tana tili. Oltinchi: vaqtni oshirish — uch daqiqa oltiga aylanmaydi.

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
board: 'Ummm, so, like, we have a slide that says…'
'As you can see here in this very busy slide…'
scenes.say_native: Uch jumlani to‘g‘rilang. Bir: 'Ummm, so, like…' — bitta pauza bilan boshlang. Ikki: 'As you can see here in this very busy slide…' — bitta raqamni ajrating: 'The key figure here is…' Uch: 'Any questions?' — 'What questions do you have?' deb ochiq so‘rang va besh soniya kuting. Har jumlani ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Fix three lines. One: 'Ummm, so, like…' — open with one calm beat instead. Two: 'As you can see here in this very busy slide…' — pick one number: 'The key figure here is…'. Three: 'Any questions? … Okay, fine.' — ask 'What questions do you have?' and wait five full seconds. Say each fix aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Uch jumlani to‘g‘rilang. Bir: 'Ummm…' — bitta pauza. Ikki: 'very busy slide' — bitta raqam: 'The key figure here is…'. Uch: 'Any questions?' — 'What questions do you have?' va besh soniya jimlik. Har jumlani ovoz chiqarib ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: xatolarni tuzatish

examples.t: The key figure here is forty-two per cent.
examples.uz: Mana bu yerda asosiy raqam — qirq ikki foiz.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: 'Ummm…' o‘rniga bir soniya jimlik, keyin 'Good morning. One number first.' Ikki: band slayddan bitta raqam — 'The key figure here is…'. Uch: 'Any questions?' emas — 'What questions do you have?' va jim besh soniya; kelmasa, o‘zingiz savol berib javobingizni takrorlang.
scenes.say: Answers. One: one second of silence, then 'Good morning. One number first.' Two: rescue the busy slide with 'The key figure here is…' — one number only. Three: 'What questions do you have?' plus five silent seconds; if nothing comes, ask and answer one question yourself.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: bir soniya jimlik — 'Good morning. One number first.' Ikki: band slayddan bitta raqam — 'The key figure here is…'. Uch: 'What questions do you have?' va besh soniya jimlik; kelmasa, o‘zingiz savol bering.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: Q&A — bahsli savol
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — taqdimotdan keyingi savol-javob. Rahim keskin savol beradi: 'Why should I approve this at all?' Jasur A.C.A.R.ni qo‘llaydi — tan oladi, javob beradi, kayfiyatni o‘zgartiradi va harakat taklifi bilan tugatadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Rahim: 'Why should I approve this at all? Last time failed.' Jasur: 'Fair challenge. Last time we had no training and no stop point. Today you get both: week-one training and a three-month pilot with a clear exit. If the pilot misses, we stop. The cost of doing nothing is nine hundred cold leads a year. So: approve the pilot Friday?' Rahim: '…One-page summary.' Jasur: 'Sending it right after this call. Thank you.'
scenes.say_uz: Rahim: 'Why should I approve this at all? Last time failed.' Jasur: 'That's a fair challenge. Last time we had no training and no stop point. Today you get both: week-one training and a three-month pilot with a clear exit. If the pilot misses, we stop. The cost of doing nothing is another nine hundred cold leads this year. So: approve the pilot Friday?' Rahim: '…One-page summary.' Jasur: 'Sending it right after this call. Thank you.'

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: Rahim qanday savol berdi? Ikki: Jasur nimani tan oldi — o‘tgan safar nima yetishmaganini? Uch: yangi rejaga ikkita qanday himoya kirdi? To‘rt: suhbat qanday yakunlandi — Rahim nima so‘radi? Javoblarni ichingizda saqlang.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what did Rahim challenge? Two: what did Jasur concede was missing last time? Three: what two protections does the new plan offer? Four: how did the exchange end — what did Rahim ask for? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: Rahim qanday savol berdi? Ikki: Jasur o‘tgan safar nima yetishmaganini tan oldi? Uch: rejada qanday ikkita himoya bor? To‘rt: suhbat qanday yakunlandi? Javoblarni ichingizda saqlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
board: 2. Training va stop point yo‘q edi
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: Rahim nima uchun umuman tasdiqlashi kerakligini so‘radi — 'last time failed'. Ikki: Jasur o‘tgan safar mashg‘ulot va to‘xtatish nuqtasi yo‘qligini tan oldi. Uch: ikkita himoya — week-one training va uch oylik pilot. To‘rt: Rahim one-page xulosani so‘radi — bu yumshoq 'ha'.
scenes.say: Answers. One: 'Why approve this at all? Last time failed.' Two: two gaps last time — no training, no stop point. Three: two protections now — week-one training, a three-month pilot with a clean exit. Four: Rahim asked for a one-page summary — a quiet yes; Jasur promised to send it right after.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: 'Why approve this at all?' — 'last time failed'. Ikki: o‘tgan safar training va stop point yo‘q edi. Uch: ikkita himoya — week-one training, uch oylik pilot. To‘rt: Rahim one-page xulosani so‘radi — yumshoq 'ha'.

scenes.title: Yetkazish: tempo, pauza, ko‘z

examples.t: Slow down on the key number — say it twice.
examples.uz: Eng muhim raqamda sekinlashing — ikki marta ayting.

scenes.say_native: Yetkazishning uch komponenti. Tempo — daqiqasiga 150 so‘z. Eng muhim raqamda sekinlashing va ikki marta takrorlang. Pauza — nuqtalardan keyin bir soniya; tinglovchi ma’noni hazm qiladi. Ko‘z muloqoti — har odam bilan uch-to‘rt soniya, xona aylantiriladi.
scenes.say: Three delivery levers. Tempo — one hundred fifty words a minute. On the key number, slow down and say it twice. Pause — one second after full stops. Eye contact — three to four seconds per person, sweeping the room. On crucial words, raise pitch and drop speed.
scenes.say_uz: Yetkazish uch komponenti. Tempo — daqiqasiga 150 so‘z. Eng muhim raqamda sekinlashing va ikki marta ayting. Pauza — nuqtalardan keyin bir soniya. Ko‘z muloqoti — har odam bilan uch-to‘rt soniya. Muhim so‘zlarda balandroq, sekinroq.

scenes.title: 3 daqiqalik taqdimot skeleti
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa: taqdimotingizning skeletini yig‘ing — hook, agenda, birinchi nuqtaga signpost. Vaqtni hisoblang: qirq besh soniyada skeletni aytib o‘tishingiz kerak. Bu to‘liq taqdimot emas — bu ustunlar orasidagi bog‘lanishni tekshirish.
scenes.say: Final task: assemble and speak the skeleton of your three-minute talk — hook, agenda, the signpost into point one. Time yourself: forty-five seconds. It's not the full talk — it's a check that the load-bearing beams connect.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa: taqdimotingizning skeletini yig‘ing — hook, agenda, birinchi nuqtaga signpost. Qirq besh soniya. Bu to‘liq taqdimot emas — ustunlarning bog‘lanishini tekshirish.

scenes.title: O‘z-o‘zini baholash ro‘yxati
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni baholang: hook birinchi o‘n soniyada qildimmi? Agenda o‘n so‘zdan oshmadimi? Har nuqtada signpost bormi? Yopilish — xulosa, sana bilan, savollarga taklifmi? Vaqtni oshirmadimmi? Beshala belgi bo‘lsa — yozuvingiz tayyor; bo‘lmasa, ro‘yxat bo‘yicha taxrirlang.
scenes.say: Rate yourself, five ticks: hook in the first ten seconds? Agenda under ten words? A signpost per point? A close with summary, a dated action, and open questions? Inside three minutes? All five ticked — edit your homework recording against this list.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni baholang, besh belgi: hook birinchi o‘nda? Agenda o‘n so‘zdan oshmadi? Har nuqtada signpost? Yopilish — xulosa, sana, savollar? Uch daqiqada? Beshala belgi bo‘lsa — yozuvingiz tayyor.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Ochilish — hook va o‘n so‘zlik agenda, o‘ttiz soniyada. Signposting — First, Next, Finally. Slaydlar — to‘rt formula: 'As you can see', 'This chart shows', 'The key figure here is'. Savollar — A.C.A.R. Yopilish — xulosa, sana bilan harakat, savollarga taklif, oxirida 'Thank you'.
scenes.say: Sum up. Opening: hook plus a ten-word agenda, inside thirty seconds. Signposting: First, Next, Finally. Slides: four formulas — 'As you can see', 'This chart shows', 'The key figure here is', 'If you compare'. Q&A: A-C-A-R. Close: a one-line summary, a dated action, open questions, 'Thank you' last.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Ochilish — hook + o‘n so‘zlik agenda. Signposting — First, Next, Finally. Slaydlar — to‘rt formula. Savollar — A.C.A.R. Yopilish — xulosa, sana bilan harakat, savollarga ochiq taklif, oxirida 'Thank you'.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: uch daqiqalik taqdimotingizni yozib oling — hook, agenda, uch nuqta signposting bilan, kamida bitta slayd tavsifi, yakunda harakat chaqirig‘i. Ovoz yozish ham yetarli. Besh mezon: o‘z vaqtida, hook birinchi o‘nda, signpostlar, sana bilan harakat, 'Thank you' oxirida. Keyingi darsda mijozlar bilan ishlashni o‘rganamiz. Omad!
scenes.say: Homework: record your three-minute talk — hook, agenda, three signposted points, a closing call to action. Voice recording is enough. Criteria: on time, hook in ten seconds, a signpost per point, a dated action, 'Thank you' last. Next lesson: customer service. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: uch daqiqalik taqdimotingizni yozib oling — hook, agenda, uch nuqta signposting bilan, kamida bitta slayd tavsifi, yakunda harakat chaqirig‘i. Besh mezon: o‘z vaqtida, hook birinchi o‘nda, signpostlar, sana bilan harakat, 'Thank you' oxirida. Keyingi darsda mijozlar bilan ishlashni o‘rganamiz. Omad!

quiz.q: How much time should the opening of a 3-minute talk take?
quiz.why_uz: Ochilish o‘ttiz soniya — hook va qisqa agenda; undan uzun bo‘lsa tinglovchi diqqatini yo‘qotadi.

quiz.q: Which is the strongest opening line?
options: Hi, my name is Jasur and today I'll…
Good morning, everyone, nice to see you
Sixty per cent of our leads go cold in 48 hours
Today I have a short presentation for you
quiz.why_uz: Hayratlanarli hook — birinchi qatorda raqam; ism va lavozim ikkinchi o‘rinda.

options: Phrases that guide listeners through stages
A way to end the talk early
quiz.why_uz: Signposting — First, Next, Finally kabi yo‘naltiruvchi iboralar; tinglovchi adashtirmaydi.

quiz.q: Which phrase correctly introduces a chart?
options: As you can see, delays peak on Fridays
I will read the slide now
quiz.why_uz: 'As you can see…' — slaydni ko‘rsatadi; 'The key figure here is…' raqamni ajratadi.

quiz.q: In the A.C.A.R. model for questions, what does the first A stand for?
quiz.why_uz: Acknowledge — 'That's a good question'; savolni tan olish ziddiyatni yopadi.

quiz.q: What should you do if you don't know the answer to a question?
options: Say you'll find out and follow up
quiz.why_uz: 'I'll find out and follow up tomorrow' — halol va professional; taxmin qilmang.

options: To sum up: approve the pilot by Friday — what questions do you have? Thank you.
quiz.why_uz: Kuchli yopilish — xulosa + sana bilan harakat + 'What questions do you have?' + oxirida 'Thank you'.

quiz.q: What does 'The key figure here is…' do?
options: Explains one number on a busy slide
Reads every number on the slide
Hides a mistake in the data
quiz.why_uz: Band slayddan bitta raqamni ajratib ko‘rsatadi — tinglovchi chalg‘imaydi.

quiz.q: How fast should you speak in a presentation?
options: As fast as possible to fit more in
quiz.why_uz: Daqiqasiga ~150 so‘z — aniq va tabiiy; tezroq — tushunilmaydi, sekinroq — zerikarli.

quiz.q: Why should 'Thank you' come at the very end?
options: It closes the talk and hands over to Q&A
It is a rule of grammar
quiz.why_uz: 'Thank you' — yakunlovchi marosim; boshida aytilsa, taqdimot tugagan deb xato tushuniladi.
